title: apt asks you to accept an Origin and Label change
detail: The archive moved to new publishing tooling. Its Release files now carry Origin: pkg.haus and Label: pkg.haus, where before they carried neither, and apt requires that to be accepted once. Answer yes, or run apt update --allow-releaseinfo-change on machines with no one at the keyboard. Nothing else changed: same suites, same architectures, same signing key 62B67F3EA1FA6DEC.
